form.label: Hosts
form.description: Per-host inventory and findings, split by the filesystem root each component came from.

div.span: Every host that has reported an inventory. Click one to narrow the page; the picker above resets it.

search.query: | `riskability_hosts_seen` | search hostname=$hostname|s$ | lookup riskability_matchstate_lookup hostname OUTPUT n_components, matched_at | lookup riskability_openstate_host_lookup hostname OUTPUT findings, cves, kev, top_epss, rolled_at | eval counted = if(isnotnull(rolled_at), "yes", "no") | fillnull value=0 cves, findings, kev | eval top_epss = if(isnotnull(top_epss), round(top_epss * 100, 1), null()) | eval last_scan = strftime(tonumber(host_last_scan), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval quiet_for = if(isnull(host_last_scan), "never reported", tostring(round(now() - tonumber(host_last_scan)), "duration")) | eval findings = if(counted="yes", tostring(findings), "not counted yet") | eval cves = if(counted="yes", tostring(cves), "") | sort 50000 - kev, - cves | table hostname, os, release, arch, n_components, findings, cves, kev, top_epss, last_scan, quiet_for | rename hostname AS "Host", os AS "OS", release AS "Release", arch AS "Arch", n_components AS "Components", findings AS "Open findings", cves AS "CVEs", kev AS "KEV", top_epss AS "Top EPSS %", last_scan AS "Last scan", quiet_for AS "Silent for"

viz.option: No host has reported an inventory. Nothing can be assessed until swinv data reaches the index.

div.b: These are the last snapshot, not a live count.
div.span: Every number stays as the host last reported it, so a machine that stopped reporting still shows its old findings and KEV as though nothing changed. Silent for is the tell: a large value means the row is stale, not that the host is calm. A host being counted for the first time reads not counted yet under Open findings while its KEV cell still shows 0, so read that 0 as "not measured", never as a clean bill.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_hostecostate_lookup | where hostname!="__meta" | search hostname=$hostname|s$ | stats sum(components) AS components BY type | sort 50000 - components | head 25

viz.option: No inventory reported. Nothing here can be assessed.

search.query: | `riskability_open_findings_for($hostname|s$)` | where confidence!="informational" | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | eval sev = coalesce(severity, "unrated") | stats dc(cve_id) AS cves BY root, sev | eventstats sum(cves) AS rk_root_total BY root | eventstats dc(root) AS rk_roots | sort 50000 - rk_root_total, root, sev | streamstats dc(root) AS rk_rank | eval root = if(rk_rank <= 12, root, (rk_roots - 12) . " more roots") | stats sum(cves) AS cves BY root, sev | sort 50000 - cves

viz.option: No findings on this host, or it has not reported since the feed was imported.

search.query: | `riskability_open_findings_for($hostname|s$)` | eval sev = coalesce(severity, "unrated") | stats dc(cve_id) AS cves BY sev, ecosystem | sort 50000 - cves | fields sev, ecosystem, cves

viz.option: No open findings for this host, or it has not reported recently - check its last scan above.

div.span: Click a bar or a heatmap cell above to narrow this table.

search.query: | `riskability_open_findings_for($hostname|s$)` | where confidence!="informational" | eval sev = coalesce(severity, "unrated") | search $sev_filter$ $eco_filter$ | eval root = if(scope_id!="", scope_id, "host") | eval installed_version = last_version | table cve_id, package, ecosystem, installed_version, fixed_version, root, confidence, epss, title | sort 50000 - epss

viz.option: No open findings, or nothing has reported recently.
